judged_text: TopicEmbed.import silently drops category selection when record_for_host returns nil (eh.try(:category_id) is nil), with no fallback to any default category as the old embed_category setting provided. If the referer host has no matching EmbeddableHost row (e.g. host added/renamed between retriever check and import, or embed_url differing from referer), the topic is created uncategorized with no signal to the operator; the prior behavior guaranteed a configured category.

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the category assignment changed from a global fallback (`category: SiteSetting.embed_category`) to per-host lookup (`eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` then `category: eh.try(:category_id)`). The diff shows no explicit fallback if `eh` is nil (e.g., if the `EmbeddableHost` row disappears between checks and import), so the selected category can be dropped and the topic created without the intended category. However, this is largely an edge-case/race concern because other code paths now validate host allowlisting via `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` (e.g., `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`), so under normal flow `eh` should exist.
